questions.prompt: Memory-safe Rust can still contain which class of vulnerability?

options.b: Path traversal, injection, and logic bugs — memory safety is not security

questions.prompt: The fundamental Rust borrow law for aliasing XOR mutation states:

options.a: Many readers XOR one writer, never both at once
options.b: One reader and one writer together

questions.prompt: Calling unwrap() on untrusted input belongs to which risk class?

options.b: Denial of service — a crash on bad input

questions.prompt: Using ? on an Err value in a function returning Result:

options.b: Returns the Err to the caller immediately
